name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate

entry.name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; building applications with large language models
entry.audience: Developers and data scientists building applications on large language models

covers: Generative AI and large language models
Natural language processing and prompt engineering
Transformers such as BERT and GPT
Frameworks including PyTorch, RAG, and LangChain
Building and deploying AI applications and chatbots
reading.format: 16-course series delivered online through Coursera, with hands-on labs, projects, and a guided project to build a real-world generative AI application.
reading.summary: This is a 16-course professional certificate from IBM on Coursera. It teaches generative AI engineering, including large language models, natural language processing, machine learning, and deep learning with Python. Learners build and deploy generative AI applications, agents, and chatbots using frameworks such as Flask, PyTorch, RAG, and LangChain. Completing it earns an IBM certificate that demonstrates job-ready skills.
reading.audience: The page lists aspiring generative AI engineers, AI developers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, and AI research engineers as the intended audience. It is beginner level and states no prior experience is required.
reading.prerequisites: No prior experience required; beginner level.
